target_customer: E-commerce companies and engineering teams wanting ML-driven recommendations and decisions optimized for long-term value
problem: Building production contextual bandit and reinforcement learning systems for personalization is hard for most e-commerce teams. Bandit ML offered an API that makes decisions to optimize long-term metrics such as customer lifetime value.
business_model: Usage-based ML decision API for e-commerce, with an open source core library

founders.name: Edoardo Conti
founders.background_notes: Former senior ML engineer; the open source library draws on Facebook's ReAgent platform.

founders.name: Joseph Gilley
founders.background_notes: At Uber from 2014 to 2020; built geospatial indexing for dynamic pricing; earlier worked on CubeSat communication bus.

exit.reason: Described by the buyer as a strategic acquihire to build a platform for the food supply chain.

technical_complexity.rationale: Production contextual bandits and offline policy evaluation require specialized ML expertise; founders were former authors of an industrial RL platform.

defensibility.rationale: Core library was open source under GPL, and personalization vendors and cloud providers offered recommendation services.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not copied or bought for product; the team was absorbed by Silo in May 2022 in an acquihire.

market_need_then: E-commerce growth in 2020 raised demand for personalization, while few teams had expertise in bandit and reinforcement learning methods that the founders had built at Facebook and Uber.

branding.name_origin: Named after the contextual bandit algorithm family the product is built on, inferred from the open source library description; no source states the origin explicitly.
branding.domain_note: Used banditml.com; GitHub organization banditml and PyPI package banditml.
branding.brand_signature: Open source banditml Python library for contextual bandits
branding.community_and_virality: Open source GitHub repository and PyPI releases; no merch or fan communities found.

brand_strength.rationale: Known mostly to ML engineers through the open source library; no press on the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Bandit ML raised a small seed in 2020 on the strength of founders from Facebook AI, Uber and Twitter and shipped an open source bandit library. It did not reach a larger round and the team was acquihired by Silo Technologies in May 2022, with the product wound into a food supply chain effort, so the exit was a soft landing; the stated reason is the buyer's, and customer traction is not public.
notes: banditml.com failed to resolve (DNS error), treated as dead. Seed amount $1.32M from a TechCrunch snippet, while CB Insights lists $130K total; unreconciled. Seed month September per snippet. No dated 2020 competitor sources found; results were recent vendor pages. Failure factors reflect the acquihire; weak_willingness_to_pay is an inference from the small funding and should be treated as low-confidence.
